findings.interpretation: On the same 12 exact synthetic controls, saved F1 at slots 2/4/6 is F 0.612903/0.612903/0.510638, G3 0.612903/0.586207/0.478261, and G4 0.555556/0.454545/0.641509. These observed scores do not support a general claim that additional inspection slots improve quality. This is descriptive evidence for the three predeclared methods, not a post-test comparator selection or a causal isolation of individual actions.

F at slots 2 and 4 has the same saved TP19/FP19/FN5, but empty-report counts are 4 and 5, duplicate candidates 2 and 3, and group intervals differ. Equal aggregate F1 does not establish identical per-scene predictions, geometry, support, or coverage.

findings.interpretation: All 12 synthetic executions per method and budget completed, with zero saved generation failures and zero invalid/failed actions. Schema-failed synthetic reports nevertheless occur: F 0/0/1, G3 0/1/0, G4 2/2/0 at slots 2/4/6. These remain in the expected-scene denominators. The comparison includes semantic report validation losses and cannot be attributed solely to quantitative measurement utility. Raw metrics include outputs later rejected by whole-report schema checks and/or numeric verification; they are not a separately validated no-verifier treatment.

Synthetic saved action totals are 24/48/72 per method across 12 scenes at slots 2/4/6. Thus the saved synthetic cohorts consumed all allocated slots in aggregate. Real saved totals are 12 and 24 per method across six scenes at slots 2 and 4. These are executed-action attempt counts, not generation-call counts; F additionally generates adaptive action choices. A configured budget is generally a ceiling and should not be substituted for measured actions in other cohorts.

Saved event intervals use 2000 provenance-group bootstrap draws, seed603, 12 independent synthetic groups, and one frozen model configuration. They quantify group sampling for each displayed method/budget score. They are neither paired budget-effect intervals nor model-seed uncertainty. Overlapping or non-overlapping marginal intervals do not license a paired significance, equivalence, or non-inferiority claim. No additional test or interval was computed for this audit.

findings.interpretation: Each real budget summary covers the same six scenes in five provenance groups with zero eligible reference-scored episodes and null event metrics. Reporting their emissions, schema, actions, tokens, and recorded costs is possible; real detection accuracy is unavailable. H1 has no validation-selected fixed comparator and H4 has no eligible real-reference scores. The synthetic results do not justify filling this missing comparator post-test.

Recorded CUDA means include equal batch shares and selected event spans, not serial request latency, total GPU occupancy, or a measured marginal cost of a slot. The model, acoustic tools, and verifier share GPU_LOCK; the earlier claim of an unlocked verifier was withdrawn in the additive timing correction. Verification is not separately CUDA-timed, and setup/transfer/display work is not completely covered. Worker wall durations include waits and can overlap host work. Budget2/4 use the same three methods, while main6 schedules five methods across a larger cohort. Batch composition, output length, and concurrent queues therefore differ. The saved G3 synthetic CUDA means (15.6375/15.8803/15.0027 seconds) are a concrete reason not to assume monotonic timing from slot counts.

findings.interpretation: Only the saved six-scene real summaries for slots 2 and 4 are included here. The main real summary covers 90 scenes and must not substitute for the matched six-scene slot6 cohort. No main real subgroup was filtered, averaged, or otherwise scientifically recomputed on CPU. The queued CUDA Figure9 matched-subset export is required before a three-budget real cost comparison.

Exact synthetic scores use the frozen greedy descending-quality one-to-one matching and fixed tolerances. Known optional beat-envelope harmonics receive neither credit nor penalty; unenumerated modulation is excluded where modulation_exhaustive is false. These are 12 controlled scenes with the declared event scope, not a dense or exhaustive validation of all acoustic content or real-world generalization. Emission coverage and the final declared_abstention flag describe retained reports; verifier rejection can set abstention and must not all be attributed to an autonomous model choice.

conservative_conclusion: All evaluated budget episodes completed. On the shared exact controls, event recovery varies by method and budget without consistent gains from additional slots; report-schema losses and coverage differ. These are small-control descriptive results with individual-score group intervals, not paired superiority tests. Real accuracy and the validation-selected comparator remain unavailable. Saved timing is incomplete, batch-amortized, and schedule-specific; matched real slot6 costs await their CUDA export.
